snippet.title: Magic Carpet gameplay (PC Game, 1994)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Magic Carpet, Dos PC game produced by Electronic Arts in 1994 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/magic-carpet/474/
Playing and completing first scenario. Setting SVGA mode (use R key to enable that).
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
